text: ok i just painted some and they still are not showing up
resolution: Same investigation as req_1465 (duplicate capture of 'painted palms not showing'). Root cause = grove sparsity too low for a small paint (0.06 → often 0 palms on 25 cells); fixed by raising cellChance to 0.22, verified 10 palms bake from the live map. See req_1465 for the full trace. Also confirmed with the user that the bake reading 3 painted chunks instead of 9 is expected (they toggled 6 chunks off), not a bug.
